original_en: At 10.5 seconds, make the right hand pull the loose mandarin peel with three short tugs over four seconds.
original_zh: 在第 10.5 秒，让右手在四秒内以三次短促拉动扯动松散的橘皮。
atoms_en: Does the right hand pull the loose mandarin peel with repeated tugs?
Are the tugs short?
Does the hand make exactly three tugs?
Are all three tugs completed within 4 seconds?
atoms_zh: 右手是否反复拉扯松散的橘皮？
每次拉动是否短促？
右手是否恰好拉动三次？
三次拉动是否在 4 秒内完成？

original_en: At 23 seconds, make the loose orange peel pieces on the plate dry, curled and brittle.
original_zh: 在第 23 秒，让盘中的松散橙皮碎片变得干燥、卷曲且易碎。
atoms_en: Do the loose orange-peel pieces on the plate become dry?
Do the orange-peel pieces become curled?
Do the orange-peel pieces appear brittle?
atoms_zh: 盘中的松散橙皮碎片是否变得干燥？
橙皮碎片是否卷曲？
橙皮碎片是否呈现易碎状态？

original_en: At 24.5 seconds, separate the mandarin on the white plate into two clusters of connected segments.
original_zh: 在第 24.5 秒，将白盘中的橘子分成两簇，每簇内部的橘瓣仍相连。
atoms_en: Is the mandarin on the white plate separated into exactly two clusters?
Do the segments within each cluster remain connected?
atoms_zh: 白盘中的橘子是否被分成恰好两簇？
每簇内部的橘瓣是否仍保持相连？

original_en: At 16 seconds, make both hands slide the lower dishwasher rack halfway inward and back out over four seconds.
original_zh: 在第 16 秒，让双手在四秒内将洗碗机下层碗篮向内推至一半，再拉回外侧。
atoms_en: Do both hands slide the lower dishwasher rack halfway inward?
Do both hands then slide the rack back out, completing the inward-and-outward motion within four seconds?
atoms_zh: 双手是否将洗碗机下层碗篮向内推至一半？
随后双手是否将碗篮拉回外侧，并在 4 秒内完成这一往返动作？
